evidence:
Figure 1 : (a) Novel-view synthesis provides paired views with shared action labels, but these labels do not specify which physical regions should support prediction.
(b) Point clouds capture different visible surfaces across views, while geometry alone may not identify task-relevant regions.
(c) ReGeoAnch uses global and gripper-local anchors as shared spatial references.
(c.1) Point-to-Anchor Aggregation pools visible points within each anchor’s neighborhood, providing more stable cross-view geometry to mitigate point-set variation.
(c.2) Anchor-to-Policy Readout decouples the fusion with appearance to guide anchor selection, while combining geometric values for action prediction.
